strategy: Record existing focused tests rather than add duplicate source files.

frameworks.framework: pytest with WebTest and fakeredis FullStackTests harness

smoke_tests.value: Confirms the upgraded React/Jest toolchain can render and assert a small component in CI mode.

integration_tests.value: Creates a temp collection through the application API, verifies collection get/list read paths return the seeded fixture, and deletes it.

notes: No new source test files were added because existing focused tests already cover the Stage 3 smoke and empty-datastore integration requirements.
